title: Leo at 3 AM: did they like me?
caption: Lying awake wondering if they liked you or just the confetti cannon? At 3 AM Leo's group chat lights up: everyone is awake, and everyone stayed after the show. You're loved offstage. Send this to the Leo who's still up.
